[[File:Third_Eye.png|thumb|The ''Third Eye'']]
The '''''Third Eye''''' was a Hutt spy vessel equipped with high-resolution optics and signal monitors. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]] the Sith Empire destroyed the vessel to prevent it from discovering their base at [[Gravity Hook Seven]].
